blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–San Beda made easy work of San Sebastian in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament, 85-55, on Friday at San Juan Arena to barge back into the win column. After a sorry one-point loss to Mapua earlier in the week, the Red Lions bounced back with a 30-point rout of the still-winless Golden Stags to improve to 3-2. “After that Mapua game, we just had to be confident in our game,” said San Beda assistant coach Andre Santos. “We had to be present.
